title: The ball integral x ↦ ∫_{B_r(x) × G(N,n)} β(S) dν is Borel
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let G(N,n) = Grassmannian N n (projection matrices with the subspace topology and Borel σ-algebra), and let ν be an s-finite measure on ℝ^N × G(N,n) (product σ-algebra). Then for every r ∈ ℝ and every continuous β : G(N,n) → ℝ, the map ℝ^N → ℝ, x ↦ ∫_{B_r(x) × G(N,n)} β(S) dν(y, S), is Borel measurable. Here B_r(x) = closedBall x r and the integral is the Bochner set integral, which is 0 when the integrand is not ν-integrable on B_r(x) × G(N,n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)), SFinite ν → ∀ (r : ℝ) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), Measurable (fun x : Euclidean N ↦ ∫ z in closedBall x r ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂ν)
